reviews.title: easy to assemble!
reviews.body: I recently purchased a bookshelf for my preschooler, and it has quickly become a beloved addition to our home! One of the standout features is its perfect height; both my daughter and her toddler brother can easily see and reach their favorite books, encouraging independent reading.The fabric shelves are a fantastic design choice, allowing books of all heights to be displayed without worry. This not only reduces the weight of the bookshelf, making it easy to move around, but it also helps keep our reading area flexible and fun. The forward-facing design is a game changer, as it allows my little ones to quickly and easily choose which story they want to dive into.We also love the color—it matches her bed beautifully, and the neutral brown tone means it will seamlessly fit into other areas of our home as she grows. Overall, this bookshelf is not just functional but also aesthetically pleasing, making it a wonderful investment for fostering a love of reading in our kids. I highly recommend it for any family looking to enhance their little one's reading nook!It only took me about 10 minutes to assemble!

reviews.title: great for my 3 year old's bedroom
reviews.body: my 3 year old loves books and this is easy for her to choose a book from and then return it to the shelf. this would not be enough storage or tall enough for 6 and up I don't think. It's prefect for preschoolers. easy to assemble, pretty sturdy for an inexpensive furniture piece. I have 2 - good for boy and girl twins. We will enjoy using it then pass it down to the next preschoolers, I am confident it will hold up for more than just my twins.

reviews.title: Good for book organization
reviews.body: Bookshelf was very easy to put together. Appearance is nice but it does wobble a bit. Would recommend tethering to a wall if in a young child’s room. The fabric is thick and holds approx 6 small books on each shelf without overlapping them. They are deep enough to hold larger books without them leaning forward as well. Overall a good purchase to keep books organized and viewable. Small (height wise) enough for a child to reach all the books.
